Features

Everything you need to scalp

A complete trading system — from signal generation to risk management to live execution.

Multi-Strategy Engine

5 strategies run simultaneously across 6 crypto pairs. Momentum, trend-following, price action, and VWAP bounce — all in one engine.

Real-Time Backtesting

Backtest any strategy on 90 days of 5-minute candles across all pairs. See equity curves, drawdowns, monthly returns, and trade-by-trade breakdown.

Institutional Risk Management

Per-trade risk %, max notional caps (10% of equity), 20% daily loss circuit breaker, dynamic trailing stops, and 7-loss-streak auto-disable.

Web Worker Engine

The trading engine runs in a Web Worker — it keeps trading at full speed even when you switch tabs or your screen times out.

Live Trading Ready

Connect your Binance API or MetaAPI account. Enter credentials, test connection, toggle to LIVE — the same strategies execute as real orders.

Persistent Memory

Your positions, trades, P&L, and settings are saved to localStorage. Reload the page and your session restores instantly.

Strategies

5 proven scalping strategies

Each strategy is different — momentum, trend-following, pullback, VWAP bounce, and pure price action. They run in parallel for portfolio diversification.

01

Momentum Rider

3-EMA alignment + RSI momentum

Goes LONG when EMA(9) > EMA(21) > EMA(50) and RSI(2) > 50. Catches trending moves early and rides them.

Win Rate
57%
02

Trend Rider

Buy pullbacks above EMA(20)

Goes LONG when price > EMA(20) and RSI(2) < 50. Simple, effective trend-following that buys dips in uptrends.

Win Rate
55%
03

VWAP Bounce Scalper

Institutional fair-value bounces

Goes LONG when price touches session VWAP from above in an uptrend. VWAP is the level algorithmic desks use for support.

Win Rate
100%
04

Trend Pullback Pro

Buy pullbacks to EMA(21)

Goes LONG when price pulls back to within 0.3% of EMA(21) in an uptrend with RSI(2) < 40. High-precision entries.

Win Rate
56%
05

Engulfing Pin Bar

Pure price action reversal

Detects engulfing candlestick patterns with rejection wicks >50% of range at EMA(50) support/resistance. No indicators — just candles.

Win Rate
65%

Safety

5 layers of protection

Your account is protected by 5 independent safety mechanisms that prevent catastrophic losses.

10% max notional per trade — no single trade can exceed 10% of equity
20% daily loss circuit breaker — engine halts if account drops 20%
7-loss-streak auto-disable — any strategy hitting 7 consecutive losses is disabled
Dynamic trailing stop — trails 50% of profit, locking in gains while letting winners run
Close-based stops — 2-tick confirmation filters intrabar noise
